addresses.name: CAddWarGoalChange::Apply
addresses.comment: **A history file's `war_goal` entry, applied or undone** - slot 7 of CAddWarGoalChange (the class's own, by the RTTI export), the history entry CWarHistory::LoadEntry makes for the key (0x7A0). VA 0x600170 to the two `ret 4` at 0x60019E and 0x6001EB, one frame; `this` in ECX, `forward` the one stack byte. **Forward**: CWarGoal::AddToWar (rva 0x651FB0) with the embedded goal at `this+0x10` in EDI and the stack words `[this+0xC]` (the war), `[this+0x28]` and `[this+0x2C]` (the goal's actor tag and id - CWarGoal +0x18/+0x1C) - so **the replay's goal goes through AddToWar's only gate, CWarGoal::IsValidWithTrigger, the type's is_valid in the recipient's scope with THIS the actor**, and a goal that fails it is not added and stamps no cooldown. **Backward**: 0xA52750 looks up the war's per-country bucket at `war+0x9C` by the actor id, 0x47C280 finds the goal in it, 0xA52EB0 erases it. Since ExecuteHistory replays every country's history before the wars' (FINDINGS-bookmarks.md 2.2), a goal on a country already in exile by a later start's date fails `conquer`'s `government_in_exile = no` and is never added: World War II at 1941.6.22 keeps only Germany's goals on the Netherlands and the Soviet Union of the nine its file gives by then, and every `next_wargoal_date` in the 1936, 1939, 1941.6.22 and 1941.12.11 start saves is one goal so added, stamped a WARGOAL_ADD_COOLDOWN month on from the defines' start date (1936.2.1.0 at every bookmark: the lobby's tick). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-laterstart.md, section 13.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled VA 0x600170..0x6001EF (scripts/disasm.py): `cmp byte ptr [ebp+8], 0` / `je 0x6001A1`; the forward arm loads edi = ebx+0x10 and pushes [ebx+0x2C], [ebx+0x28], [ebx+0xC] before `call 0xA51FB0` (CWarGoal::AddToWar, whose recorded callers already list 0x600193); `ret 4` on both arms. hoi3_tfh-classes.json: CAddWarGoalChange introduces slot 7 at 0x600170, slot 6 at 0x600060 (`mov eax, 0x7A0; ret` - the key CWarHistory::LoadEntry files the entry under), as CExileStatusChange's slot 7 is its Apply. Measured: the four start saves' next_wargoal_date pairs (GER-SOV, GER-HOL, JAP-CGX, JAP-CHI, ITA-ETH, SPR-SPA at 1941.6.22; plus JAP-USA, JAP-PHI at 1941.12.11; GER-FRA, GER-POL, JAP-CGX, JAP-CHI, SPR-SPA at 1939.9.1; ITA-ETH at 1936) are exactly the goals whose is_valid holds at the date, OpenHOI3's new games reproducing them pair for pair. Would be shown wrong by a save at a later start holding a goal on a country that was in exile at the date, or a stamp other than start date plus the cooldown.

addresses.name: CAIStrategy_CollectConquerProvinces
addresses.comment: **The `conquer_prov` list.** Every map province in index order that is land, owned and not controlled by the country, where (Personality == military, or CCountry::IsEnemy(owner)) and (the owner is the country, or OwnerArea_TouchesController(country, province area)) and the province's strategic resource (CMapProvince +0x18) answers its slot 14 (ReturnTrue on CStrategicResource, ReturnFalse on CNullStrategicResource): CAIStrategy::AddConquerProv(province, 50) - the float 50000.5 (VA 0x160A7FC) floored and rounded to whole units. `ret 4` at 0x4A697B. **The "owner is the country" half is dead**: AddConquerProv returns at once for a province the strategy's own country owns, so a country's own land held by an enemy never reaches the list - Norway's 810 and Poland's 2096 at both 1941 starts, China's 5420 at 1939.9.1, none on the start saves' lists (FINDINGS-laterstart.md, section 14).
addresses.revises: comment only: adds that the owner-is-the-country half is dead, AddConquerProv refusing a province the country owns
addresses.evidence: Revised comment only (name, signature and confidence unchanged). Disassembled VA 0x8A67B0..0x8A697B: at 0x8A68D8 `cmp eax (owner id), [ecx+0xC] (country id)` / `je 0x8A68F5` skips OwnerArea_TouchesController (0x47EB90) into the resource test, then `call 0x8A4F50`; AddConquerProv at 0x8A4FF0..0x8A5002 loads provinces_begin[province]->owner_id (+0x330), compares it with [esi+0xC] and `je 0x8A507C` (the epilogue) before any add. Measured: Ireland1941_06_22_00 and _12_11_00 hold no conquer_prov entry for NOR 810, POL 2096 (owned by them, controlled by GER, military personality, heavy_water and helium) and Ireland1939_09_01_00 none for CHI 5420; the Soviet Union's three own provinces held by Germany at 1941.12.11 likewise. Would be shown wrong by a save listing a province its own country owns.
